# Foresight Home Inspections, LLC

> Foresight Home Inspections, LLC is a Certified Master Inspector®-led home inspection company serving Metro Atlanta, Georgia. Every inspection is performed by two certified inspectors and includes a $10,000 Elite Master Inspection Warranty at no additional cost.

## Company Facts

- Founded and led by Christopher Boykin, Certified Master Inspector® (CMI)
- Every inspection is performed by two certified inspectors, not one
- Equipped with FLIR thermal imaging cameras, high-resolution aerial drones, and electronic moisture diagnostic gear
- Licensed, insured, and bonded in the state of Georgia
- Member of the International Association of Certified Home Inspectors (InterNACHI)
- Address: 1816 South Deshon Road, Lithonia, GA 30058
- Online Scheduling: https://schedulenow.homegauge.com/11ec7d41-999d-45c5-9ccd-df7d23ece8b6/schedule
- Location: Lithonia (Metro Atlanta), Georgia, United States
- Business Hours: Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM (Thursday until 7:00 PM, Sunday by appointment)
- Service Area: Over 163 cities across Metro Atlanta and the state of Georgia
- Office phone: 678-480-2110
- Website: https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com

## Credentials and Certifications

- Christopher Boykin holds the Certified Master Inspector® (CMI) designation, the highest professional credential in the home inspection industry, awarded by the Master Inspector Certification Board
- The CMI designation requires completion of over 1,000 paid inspections and ongoing education
- All inspectors hold the Certified Professional Inspector® (CPI) designation from InterNACHI
- Every inspection includes the $10,000 Elite Master Inspection Warranty with $0 deductible, covering major appliances, structural components, mechanicals, mold remediation, and roof leak protection
